HR@10 with one positive and 99 unique sampled negatives measures success within that 100-item candidate set. It does not establish full-catalog HR@10: sampled metrics can reverse model rankings even in expectation ([Krichene and Rendle](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/)). Preserve the pinned evaluator and identical users/candidates across variants. With 200 users/category, one hit changes category HR by 0.5 percentage points and the four-category macro-average by 0.125 points. Fixed candidates improve comparability but leave candidate-sampling uncertainty unmeasured.

Recommended ablation protocol: preregister truncation lengths, baseline, primary contrasts, checkpoint-selection rule, and stopping rule. Record paired per-user hit indicators; report every variant’s category and macro HR, baseline differences in percentage points, and discordant counts (wins/losses). For paired uncertainty, resample users with replacement within each category, using identical sampled indices across variants; recompute category differences and their equally weighted macro-average. Report a prespecified 95% bootstrap interval, method, replicate count, and bootstrap seed ([paired bootstrap documentation](https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/generated/scipy.stats.bootstrap.html)). These intervals approximate user-sampling uncertainty conditional on trained models and fixed candidates; they exclude training-seed variability and population shift. With seed 42 alone, make no seed-robustness claim.

Repeatedly selecting truncation lengths, checkpoints, or ideas on the same validation users creates optimistic selection bias ([Cawley and Talbot](https://www.jmlr.org/papers/v11/cawley10a.html)). Report all validation queries and prior adaptive search; preregistration now cannot erase earlier reuse. Winner-only bootstrap intervals do not correct selection bias. Prespecify simultaneous intervals or multiplicity adjustment for planned contrasts, label adaptive findings exploratory, and reserve generalization claims for the host’s untouched final evaluation. Training diagnostics support mechanism hypotheses, not generalization evidence.
